Sandbox_ZomboidDrugzz_LootMultiplier_too: Multiplies all Knox Cannabis & Contraband procedural loot chances. Default is 1.0x; can be raised up to 10.0x. Set to 0 to disable world spawns.
Sandbox_ZomboidDrugzz_ZombieLootMultipli: Scales rare finished-drug drops in zombie pockets. Default is 1.0x; can be raised up to 10.0x. At 1.0, expect roughly one mod drug per 170 to 200 ordinary zombies. Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_ZomboidDrugzz_EffectStrength_too: Scales positive and negative stat effects.
Sandbox_ZomboidDrugzz_OverdoseSeverity_t: Scales overdose sickness and health damage. Set to 0 to disable overdose damage.
Sandbox_ZomboidDrugzz_SideEffectSeverity: Scales the chance of cottonmouth, nausea, vomiting, panic, overheating, tremors, coughing, and other drug-specific side effects. Set to 0 to disable random side effects.
Sandbox_ZomboidDrugzz_EnableDependence_t: Repeated use can create temporary withdrawal effects after a day without the drug family.
Sandbox_ZomboidDrugzz_EnableTraitStarter: Characters with a Drugzz background trait begin with a small matching supply. Trait tolerance and dependence still apply when this is disabled.
Sandbox_ZomboidDrugzz_EnableEffectMoodle: Shows custom HUD icons for active highs, trips, stimulant effects, comedowns, withdrawal, cottonmouth, nausea, overheating, green-outs, and overdose risk.
Sandbox_ZomboidDrugzz_MushroomGrowDays_t: Minimum room-temperature age before a mushroom jar can be harvested.
Sandbox_ZomboidDrugzz_CocaGrowDays_toolt: Minimum room-temperature age before a coca nursery can be harvested.
